mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_sale_order where status in ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') and confirm_time >= curdate() and confirm_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
select coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) from biz_sale_order where status in ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') and confirm_time >= curdate() and confirm_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
select coalesce(sum(refund_amount), 0) from biz_refund_record where status = 'REFUNDED' and handle_time >= curdate() and handle_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
select count(1) from biz_after_sale_ticket where status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

select s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, s.sale_price, s.stock, s.warn_stock, p.product_name, c.category_name from biz_product_sku s left join biz_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id left join biz_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' and s.stock <= s.warn_stock order by (s.warn_stock - s.stock) desc, s.stock asc, s.sku_id asc
select count(1) from biz_customer where del_flag = '0' and customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')

select count(1) from biz_refund_record r join biz_after_sale_ticket t on t.ticket_id = r.ticket_id join biz_sale_order_item i on i.item_id = t.order_item_id join biz_sale_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id

select coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount), 0) from biz_refund_record r join biz_after_sale_ticket t on t.ticket_id = r.ticket_id join biz_sale_order_item i on i.item_id = t.order_item_id join biz_sale_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id
select count(1) from biz_product_sku s join biz_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and p.del_flag = '0' and s.stock <= s.warn_stock

select o.customer_id as customerId, coalesce(c.customer_name, o.customer_name) as customerName, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount from biz_sale_order o left join biz_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.del_flag = '0'
group by o.customer_id, coalesce(c.customer_name, o.customer_name) order by orderAmount desc, o.customer_id asc

select c.customer_id as customerId, c.customer_name as customerName, coalesce(o.orderCount, 0) as orderCount, coalesce(o.orderAmount, 0) as orderAmount, coalesce(r.refundAmount, 0) as refundAmount, coalesce(o.orderAmount, 0) - coalesce(r.refundAmount, 0) as netSalesAmount from biz_customer c left join ( select o.customer_id, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount from biz_sale_order o
group by o.customer_id ) o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id left join ( select o.customer_id, coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount), 0) as refundAmount from biz_refund_record r join biz_after_sale_ticket t on t.ticket_id = r.ticket_id join biz_sale_order_item i on i.item_id = t.order_item_id join biz_sale_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id
group by o.customer_id ) r on r.customer_id = c.customer_id where c.del_flag = '0' order by netSalesAmount desc, c.customer_id asc

select o.status as status, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount from biz_sale_order o
group by o.status order by orderCount desc, o.status asc

select date_format(coalesce(o.confirm_time, o.create_time), '%Y-%m') as month, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as orderAmount from biz_sale_order o
group by date_format(coalesce(o.confirm_time, o.create_time), '%Y-%m') order by month asc
